evidence_required: SPOF table (component, impact, mitigation, fix/accept, reason); failure-domain diagram; answer to task 4.

marking.criterion: At least five correct SPOFs, each with its service impact (for example network-rack single PDU, border router, load balancer, NFS weight server, control plane on one host, DNS/NTP VM)
Failure-domain diagram showing which components share a host, rack, PDU or feed
A mitigation per SPOF with a fix or accept decision justified by cost, likelihood or recovery time
Task 4 names a placement SPOF (the three control-plane VMs on one hypervisor, or the single-feed network-rack PDU)

title: Five single points of failure
